answer: A workable design: lock a compute bond for six epochs and slash it the moment two answers fingerprint-match. Clustering on shared timing signatures exposes the operator. Because it works by converting a one-time spend into a recurring per-account bill, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. The timber of work and the vault of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a tundra to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
